_verified: 2026-09-13: tier ids confirmed present in models.list and both pinged clean. max_output_tokens read from the provider's own over-limit 400 ('This model supports at most 128000 completion tokens'). reasoning_effort 'minimal' is REJECTED by both tiers ('does not support minimal with this model'); 'low' works. temperature is rejected — only the default is accepted. max_context_tokens is NOT verified: this provider exposes no context window through models.retrieve, which returns id/created/owned_by only.

light._note: One API key serves both tiers — OpenAI does not split keys by tier. max_context_tokens is a documented figure the provider does not report; it is used only by the PDF guard's context check. thinking_levels omits 'minimal' because this model rejects it outright — the same shape as gemini-3.8-flash rejecting thinking_level 'minimal'.

heavy._fallback_note: Unversioned aliases; the response reports a dated build (gpt-5.6-sol -> gpt-5.6-sol), so a provider-side version change is only visible through model_version on the response.

request_constraints._note: Rejected parameters, each verified with a live 400 rather than assumed.
request_constraints._store_note: store=false is sent on every request. This platform handles incident data, so a no-retention posture is a declared property of the client, not an incidental default.

application/pdf._verified: 2026-09-24, both tiers (gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-sol), inline base64 input_file. tokens_per_page MEASURED: (document-call input_tokens - same prompt as text) / pages on the 3-page probe PDF; identical on both tiers. media_resolution maps to input_file detail (low->low, medium->auto, high->high); on the text-only probe the three cost the same within 2 tokens, so a page with images may cost more at high than recorded here. max_pages is the LARGEST COUNT VERIFIED, not a refusal: 101 and 600 pages were accepted and counted correctly; no page cap was found below the 400,000-token context window, which binds first at ~660 pages. max_size_mb is DOCUMENTED (50 MB per file and per request) and applies to the decoded file: a 40 MB PDF (53 MB as base64) was accepted, though it took 126 s to upload from a home connection.
application/pdf._note: Inline only, never the Files API: an upload is retained provider-side until deleted, which would undo store=false. No gs_uri path: this provider cannot read a GCS URI, so the dispatcher reads the bytes first (no remote_uri_gs capability).

output_budget._note: Reasoning tokens are completion tokens and come out of max_completion_tokens — measured: at a 64-token cap gpt-5-mini spent all 64 on reasoning and returned empty content with finish_reason 'length'. Sizing a reply against the full cap truncates it. max_completion_tokens is a ceiling, not a charge, so reserving generously costs nothing unless spent.
